rootCauses.previewAlias: Primary generated deployment origin rejected configured custom branch alias with HTTP 403. Added finite server-configured preview origins to activation/actions/deactivation/review and shared consumer origin resolution. No incoming Host/forwarded header trust or wildcard allowance.
rootCauses.streamedSave: Urgent saved-RSC updates and render-time accepted-tree mutation could expose suspended server children and tear down the native editor. Keep accepted snapshots at commit boundaries and transition server-tree acceptance/ownership release.
rootCauses.newBlockInline: Payload native ADD_ROW prepares leaf metadata asynchronously; preserve explicit inline intent while metadata is pending instead of opening a competing panel.
